nodes.label: MGR05 receipts, director approval and allocation preparation
nodes.summary: Eight scoped manager routes via one ManagerFinanceFacade. MDL only new receipts, exact money, immutable receipt/rejection, DB pagination, CSRF/UUID-key and cached replay scope checks. Manager confirm requests director approval without Ledger mutation. Existing director flow publishes, revokes earlier active limited admissions and issues missing paid rights at cumulative full payment on manager-prepared allocations. Prepares purchase/allocation and installment top-ups; recipient view never exposes foreign receipt amount/note/household totals. Distribution identity allows one receipt to fund two children. MGR04 facade centralized; bounded MGR07 adjustment port requires approval.71 own tests,311 affected plus schema,Finance and worker checks;387 unique assertions. Migration unapplied; mocks do not prove live PostgreSQL races/grants.
